title: Behind the set design | Bacchae Schools Tour | National Theatre
description:
Set and Costume Designer Natalie Jhonson discusses the creative challenge of reimagining a prodcution from the Olivier main stage to 
school halls across the country. 
 
National Theatre’s Touring for Schools will return in Autumn 2026  with a tour of Bacchae, schools' version, by Nima Taleghani, directed by Hannah Hauer-King. Desinger Natalie Jhonson

-- 
We believe that great theatre sparks imagination and brings people together.

Every day we strive to make the world a better place through theatre; entertaining and inspiring audiences around the world, using our creativity, expertise and unique reach.

You’ll find us in theatres. In cinemas. In schools. And online.

title: Lighting Design & Career Sustainability in Theatre and Live Events: Josh Selander | Anna Robb
description:
In this episode of the Theatre Art Life podcast, host Anna Robb sits down with lighting designer, programmer, and educator Josh Selander. 

From teaching at UNCSA to programming world-class shows for Criss Angel, Cirque du Soleil, and BRC Imagination Arts, Josh shares invaluable insights into navigating a versatile, high-level career in live entertainment and themed experiences.   

Timestamps & Topics
00:00 – Intro: The Perks & Reality of Freelance Life   
01:15 – Welcome Josh Selander: From UNCSA to Global Shows   
02:54 – Starting Out: Turning a High School Hobby into a Career   
04:20 – Mentorship in Lighting: Finding the Right Guidance   
05:57 – Teaching at UNCSA: Spotting Potential & Allowing Career Pivots   07:45 – Returning to UNCSA: Bringing Real-World Tech into the Classroom   
09:21 – Why University-Manufacturer Partnerships Matter   
10:14 – Balancing Different Genres: Themed Entertainment vs. Live Shows   
12:58 – Designer vs. Programmer: Key Differences in the Workflow   14:48 – Overlapping Projects, Student Involvement, and Avoiding Burnout   
17:31 – Transitioning Back to Las Vegas After 8 Years of Teaching   18:36 – Inside the Design: The Grand Ole Opry Visitor Experience   
21:31 – Maintaining Themed Installations & Remote System Monitoring   25:03 – How to Consistently Land Freelance Work as a Good Human   28:22 – Pros & Cons of Full Freelance Freedom vs. Structure   
31:01 – Managing Free Time, Biking, and Traveling for Gigs   
34:19 – Post-Pandemic Boundaries & Setting Realistic Schedules   37:11 – Working 5-Day vs. 6-Day Production Weeks   
39:43 – What Josh Loves Most About the Entertainment Industry   
42:07 – Improving Industry Accessibility for Young Professionals
